issues.description: The problem statement and UML require getters for each attribute (used in tests), implying they should be publicly accessible. In the solution, getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private, while the other getters are public. This visibility mismatch will prevent students or tests from accessing these getters as specified and is inconsistent with the exercise instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public so that all attribute getters are public and consistent with the problem description and UML. Ensure the template and solution both declare these getters as public.
